candidates.explanation: The duplicate-email check is inverted: it throws emailExists only when the user found by the new email has the same id as the current user. That can't happen here, because the email differs from the current one. When the email belongs to a different account, userByEmail.id !== currentUser.id, so no error is thrown. The code goes on to sign the confirmation hash and send the mail, and the request returns 200. The condition should be userByEmail.id !== currentUser.id, or just if (userByEmail).

fix.description: In AuthService.update, change the condition `if (userByEmail && userByEmail.id === currentUser.id)` to `if (userByEmail && userByEmail.id !== currentUser.id)`. Since the email already differs from the current user's, `if (userByEmail)` also works. This throws the 422 emailExists before any confirmation mail is sent.
